act-relu.hypothesis: ReLU instead of GELU: a hard zero below zero rather than a smooth gate. Cheaper, and the classic comparison.

act-swiglu.hypothesis: SwiGLU: a gated MLP as used by Llama, with hidden width scaled by 2/3 to keep parameters comparable.

baseline.hypothesis: GPT-style reference: GELU, LayerNorm, learned positions, 6 heads, 6 layers.

context-128.hypothesis: Half the context. Attention cost is quadratic in sequence length, so throughput should rise while long-range structure is lost.

context-512.hypothesis: Double the context. Quadratic attention cost should reduce throughput; TinyStories are short, so the benefit may be small.

control-no-causal-mask.hypothesis: Removing the causal mask lets the model attend to future tokens, so next-token prediction becomes trivial. Validation loss should collapse far below baseline. If it does not, masking is broken.

control-no-position.hypothesis: Without positional information attention is permutation-invariant, so the model can only learn token frequencies. Loss should worsen clearly against baseline.

gqa-2kv.hypothesis: Grouped-query attention: 6 query heads sharing 2 key/value heads, cutting KV projection size and memory.

heads-1.hypothesis: One head: same parameter count, but a single attention pattern per layer instead of six specialised subspaces.

heads-12.hypothesis: Twelve heads: more subspaces, each of dimension 32 instead of 64. Tests whether head count or per-head width matters more.

heads-2.hypothesis: Two heads - intermediate point in the head-count sweep.

layers-10.hypothesis: Deeper at the same width. More parameters and more compute per token, so throughput should drop.

layers-2.hypothesis: Shallow: 2 layers. Tests how much depth contributes at fixed width.

llama-style.hypothesis: All Llama-style choices together: RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU and grouped-query attention, against the GPT-style baseline.

norm-rmsnorm.hypothesis: RMSNorm drops mean subtraction and the shift parameter. Tests whether re-centring contributes anything at this scale.

pos-rope.hypothesis: Rotary embeddings inject relative position inside attention and remove the learned position table entirely.

tied-embeddings.hypothesis: Sharing input and output embedding weights halves the embedding budget. Tests whether the saving costs quality.

vocab-16384.hypothesis: Vocabulary 16384: larger vocabularies compress text into fewer tokens but spend more parameters on embeddings.

vocab-2048.hypothesis: Vocabulary 2048: larger vocabularies compress text into fewer tokens but spend more parameters on embeddings.

vocab-8192.hypothesis: Vocabulary 8192: larger vocabularies compress text into fewer tokens but spend more parameters on embeddings.
